status: PROVISIONAL - v3 plus one rule found on test20b (2026-11-18). Judge it on test20c (new patients).
decision_rule: 1. If the condition needs contrast and the scan is not a contrast scan: 'cannot assess'.

2. If a measurement exists and its value is outside the grey zone, the measurement decides (basis 'measured'). The classifier and AI readers are flagged for the reviewer when they disagree; they do not overrule.
2b. Image quality gates: a measurement over its noise limit is 'not measured'; with poorly inflated lungs emphysema cannot be 'absent'; ground-glass and enlarged heart cannot be 'present'.
3. Without a decisive measurement, 'absent' needs the classifier <= low threshold (basis 'classifier only, uncalibrated').
4. Everything else: 'cannot tell'. AI readers are shown but do not vote (readers_vote = false); the classifier alone never makes a condition 'present'.
banned_terms_note: The clinician reviewer (2026-11-15): radiologist reviewers will not accept the generic word. Use ground-glass, consolidation, or 'increased lung density, type not determined'.

contrast_aorta_hu.note: median HU of the eroded TotalSegmentator aorta; unenhanced blood is about 30-60 HU

measurements.dependent_band_note: Per axial slice and lung, the most posterior 20% of the lung's front-to-back extent is 'dependent' (gravity-related density in a supine patient). Density there is reported but not used to call ground-glass or consolidation.
measurements.aortic_calcium_note: Added 2026-11-17 after the first CT-RATE run (valid_5): with 1 mm slices, blood noise forms small clusters just above 130 HU. A calcium spot must now also contain at least one voxel >= 300 HU. Measurement fix, not a threshold change.

lung_inflation.note: Well-inflated lungs at full inspiration usually have a median of about -820 to -870 HU and 4-7 litres; pilot case valid_827 (emphysema missed) had -746 HU and 2.5 L.

conditions.label: Ground-glass
conditions.measured_by: non-dependent lung with HU -700 to -300, % of lung
conditions.note: Partial volume around vessels and motion also fall in this band; type separation by HU alone is approximate.

conditions.label: Consolidation
conditions.measured_by: non-dependent lung with HU -300 to 100, mL

conditions.label: Atelectasis
conditions.note: Only collapse next to fluid is measured; other atelectasis relies on the classifier (absent only).
conditions.measured_by: dense lung within 15 mm of a pleural effusion (E88), mL

conditions.label: Lung nodule
conditions.note: No nodule detector in the pipeline yet.

conditions.label: Emphysema
conditions.measured_by: LAA-950 on lung minus airways (E31), % of lung
conditions.note: Present only when clearly high (>= 6%). Mild emphysema often gives a low value, so a low value means 'cannot tell', not 'absent'.

conditions.label: Bronchiectasis
conditions.note: Airway-tree measurements are not yet validated as bronchiectasis evidence (planned: airway-to-artery ratio).

conditions.label: Pleural effusion
conditions.measured_by: TotalSegmentator pleural effusion mask, mL (both sides)

conditions.label: Pericardial effusion
conditions.note: Up to about 50 mL of pericardial fluid is normal.

conditions.label: Cardiomegaly (enlarged heart)
conditions.measured_by: axial cardiothoracic ratio = widest heart / widest inner chest (lungs)
conditions.note: Axial CT ratio, not the chest X-ray ratio; 0.50-0.55 is a grey zone.

conditions.label: Aortic wall calcification
conditions.measured_by: voxels >= 130 HU in/at the aorta mask (non-contrast only), mL
conditions.note: Only measurable without contrast (contrast-filled blood is also above 130 HU).

conditions.label: Pulmonary embolism
conditions.note: Needs a contrast CT (CT pulmonary angiogram).

reliability.contrast: moderate - aorta density threshold; standard physiology, not validated here
reliability.effusion_masks: moderate - TotalSegmentator pleural/pericardial effusion model (published validation by its authors), not validated on this project's data
reliability.cardiothoracic_ratio: low-moderate - computed from predicted heart and lung masks; axial CT ratio differs from the chest X-ray ratio; not validated here
reliability.heart_volume: moderate - TotalSegmentator heart mask; includes pericardium region
reliability.aortic_calcium: low-moderate - HU threshold at the predicted aorta; nearby bone or contrast can add voxels
reliability.density_type: low - HU bands inside predicted lungs; separates ground-glass from consolidation only approximately; partial volume and motion add voxels
reliability.dependent_density: low - context only; gravity-related density at the back of the lungs is usually normal
reliability.noise: moderate - standard deviation in the predicted aorta; plaques and mask edges add a little
reliability.lung_inflation: moderate - volume and median density inside predicted lungs; thresholds provisional
reliability.emphysema_laa950: moderate - standard measure on a standard kernel; insensitive to mild disease; depends on breath-in and reconstruction

noise.note: Blood SD in the eroded aorta. Standard kernels typically give 20-40 HU.

changes_from_v2: Data: use the standard-kernel reconstruction (Philips B/A, Siemens Br40f...) instead of _a_1 (ctrate_fetch.py --recon soft).

Noise: no smoothing any more (it erased emphysema holes and added ground-glass). Each HU-threshold measurement is skipped ('not measured', so 'cannot tell') above its own blood-noise limit: emphysema, calcium and ground-glass 45 HU, consolidation 60 HU. On test20 every emphysema extra had noise 31-56 HU.
Breath-in check (E95 total lung volume, E96 median lung HU): poor inflation if median above -780 HU or volume below 3000 mL. Then emphysema cannot be 'absent' and ground-glass cannot be 'present'.

Emphysema: measured on lung minus airways (E31). A low value is no longer 'absent' (no absent_below), and the classifier alone cannot make it absent either. Dark-cluster count and LAA per lobe (E32, E33) shown, not used in decisions yet.
Collapse next to fluid: consolidation-range lung within 15 mm of a pleural effusion is removed from consolidation and reported as E88; atelectasis is 'present' if E88 >= 30 mL.
Unchanged: all other thresholds, readers shown but not voting.
changes_from_v3: Enlarged heart: with poorly inflated lungs (E96/E95) the heart-to-chest ratio cannot make it 'present' (a shallow breath narrows the chest, so the ratio rises). 'absent' is still allowed. Found on test20b: both cardiomegaly extras (valid_314, valid_636) were shallow-breath scans.
